title: Lucknow Development Authority v. M.K. Gupta

content.caseIdentity: Lucknow Development Authority v. M.K. Gupta, (1994) 1 SCC 243 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Held that statutory housing development authorities fall within the definition of service providers. Delay in handing over possession of flats or houses constitutes actionable deficiency in service.
content.relevance: Extended consumer protection to real estate, housing construction, and statutory municipal boards.
